title: Isomorphic Labs announces Series C investment round

quotes.text: November 17, 2026
quotes.for: Publication date of the Isomorphic Labs announcement.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs announces it has raised $5 Billion in Series C funding. The round was co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, alongside Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and several other new investors, with continued significant investment from Alphabet.
quotes.for: The $5 billion Series C round, co-leads, Andreessen Horowitz and Alphabet.

quotes.text: The round also included participation from all existing investors: Thrive Capital, MGX, GV, CapitalG, Temasek and the UK Sovereign AI Fund.
quotes.for: Participation from all existing investors.

quotes.text: The company is scaling its proprietary drug design engine (IsoDDE) and therapeutic candidate pipeline designed with AI to deliver the next generation of medicines for patients.
quotes.for: Scaling IsoDDE and the AI-designed therapeutic pipeline.

title: Isomorphic Labs announces $5 Billion Series C funding

quotes.text: LONDON, 17 November, 2026
quotes.for: Dateline of the Isomorphic Labs Series C news release.

quotes.text: Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital co-lead the oversubscribed round as Isomorphic Labs continues to advance its foundational simulation models, progress and scale its internal and partnered medicine candidate pipeline, and build its global AI-led bioengineering infrastructure.
quotes.for: Oversubscribed round, simulation models, pipeline scaling and bioengineering infrastructure.

quotes.text: This momentum is yielding positive preclinical results, both for internal programs in oncology and immunology and with partners, setting the stage for clinical entry.
quotes.for: Positive preclinical results in oncology and immunology and partner work.

quotes.text: Proceeds will also support the company’s continued build of scalable AI-first translational and clinical development infrastructure as it advances its drug candidates to clinical trials.
quotes.for: Use of proceeds for translational and clinical development infrastructure.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs is headquartered in London and has office locations in Cambridge, Massachusetts and Lausanne, Switzerland.
quotes.for: Headquarters and office locations.

quotes.text: Isomorphic Labs is led by CEO Sir Demis Hassabis and President Max Jaderberg.
quotes.for: Leadership by Hassabis and Jaderberg.

quotes.text: Every week we are making repeatable scientific advancements enabled by our models
quotes.for: Max Jaderberg on repeatable weekly advancements.

quotes.text: routinely solving complex biological problems that have stalled traditional research for decades.
quotes.for: Max Jaderberg on solving complex biological problems.

title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials

quotes.text: Posted: 6:50 AM PST · November 17, 2026
quotes.for: Publication timestamp of the TechCrunch article.

quotes.text: The new funding, which comes on the heels of a $2.1 billion Series B round in May, will be used to continue developing its drug-design engine, as well as to foray into more types of medicine.
quotes.for: The May 2026 $2.1 billion Series B round.

quotes.text: The Series C is Isomorphic’s first fundraise since its founder and CEO, Demis Hassabis, left his position as head of DeepMind to focus on drug discovery, which also saw him moving into a chairman role at DeepMind.
quotes.for: First fundraise since Hassabis left his role as head of DeepMind to become chairman.

quotes.text: Isomorphic did not disclose its new valuation. Bloomberg reported earlier this month that the lab was looking to raise funding at a $50 billion valuation.
quotes.for: Undisclosed valuation and Bloomberg's $50 billion valuation report.

quotes.text: The lab has struck deals with pharma giants like Eli Lilly, Novartis, and Johnson & Johnson.
quotes.for: Pharmaceutical partnerships with Eli Lilly, Novartis and Johnson & Johnson.

title: Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs raises $5B to accelerate drug discovery with AI

quotes.text: UPDATED 18:51 EST / NOVEMBER 17 2026
quotes.for: Publication timestamp of the SiliconANGLE article.

quotes.text: The Alphabet unit says that multiple pharmaceutical companies are already using IsoDDE to power drug discovery programs.
quotes.for: Multiple pharmaceutical companies already using IsoDDE.

quotes.text: Isomorphic says that IsoDDE speeds up the task of finding binding pockets. When there are no such pockets, it helps researchers develop compounds that cause a target protein to form them.
quotes.for: Finding and inducing binding pockets on target proteins.

quotes.text: The process of creating 3D protein models for FEP algorithms is itself a highly complex task. It requires scientists to freeze a target protein in a crystal and scan it using specialized X-ray equipment.
quotes.for: X-ray crystallization step required by traditional FEP methods.

quotes.text: IsoDDE skips that step of the research workflow. Furthermore, Isomorphic says that the software can generate higher-quality output than FEP algorithms.
quotes.for: IsoDDE skipping crystallization and claiming higher-quality output than FEP.

quotes.text: Our drug design engine is generating molecules with unprecedented precision and speed
quotes.for: Demis Hassabis quote on IsoDDE.

title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5bn in 'one of UK tech’s biggest funding rounds'

quotes.text: Tuesday 17 November 2026 7:07 pm
quotes.for: Publication timestamp of the City A.M. article.

quotes.text: London-based AI drug discovery firm Isomorphic Labs has raised $5bn (£3.8bn) in one of the largest funding rounds in British tech, as investors bet billions on AI transforming the pharmaceutical industry.
quotes.for: GBP conversion (£3.8 billion) and London base.

quotes.text: The investment follows reports last month that Isomorphic was seeking a valuation of up to $50bn, compared with roughly $17.5bn previously.
quotes.for: Previous valuation comparison of roughly $17.5 billion and up to $50 billion target.

quotes.text: The $5bn injection comes just six months after Isomorphic secured $2.1bn in Series B funding, bringing its total disclosed external funding to approximately $7.7bn since 2025.
quotes.for: Six-month interval since Series B and $7.7 billion total disclosed external funding since 2025.

quotes.text: AI minister Kanishka Narayan welcomed the announcement, calling it “one of the biggest Series C rounds in UK tech history”.
quotes.for: UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan reaction.

quotes.text: However, despite raising billions, Isomorphic has yet to begin testing its own drug candidates in humans.
quotes.for: No human clinical trials started yet.

quotes.text: City AM understands the company remains in late-stage preclinical development, with encouraging early results across its internal oncology and immunology programmes and partnered projects.
quotes.for: Late-stage preclinical development status.
